bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BRLV is natively issued on Base. Ethereum bridgedBRLV is an issuer-operated burn/mint representation coordinated by an off-chain relayer, while the Base BRLVCanonicalGateway is canonical-side bridge machinery that tracks totalBridgedSupply, validates remote domains and replay hashes, and requests remote mints. No decentralized Base rollup bridge or proof system is involved; the relayer, gateway roles, UUPS administrators, and representation controls remain scoreable here.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex mint/bridge boundary migration; verified finding 2026-08-16

routes.reviewNote: Base is the canonical BRLV issuance deployment. The verified token is an ERC-4626-style wrapper over BRLY, and its issuer-facing mint path creates the native Base liability. BRLVCanonicalGateway is canonical-side bridge machinery for remote burn/mint accounting, not an independent issuance chain; its controls are represented below.

Ethereum is not an independent native BRLV issuer. The verified bridgedBRLV implementation is a remote-chain representation coordinated with Base by an off-chain relayer; mint() is gated by MINTER_ROLE and checks the canonical domain and processed canonical transaction hash. Its burn/mint and administrator controls are represented below.

controls.label: BRLV Base MINTER_ROLE — BRLVCanonicalGateway proxy

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The gateway burns canonical BRLV collateral on remote burns and tracks totalBridgedSupply; no separate escrowed bridge representation is used on Base.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: bridgedMint and bridgedBurn validate configured remote domains and replay hashes before cross-chain accounting and relayer requests.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No separate aggregate or per-call bridge rate limit was identified; totalBridgedSupply and availableSurplus are route-accounting invariants, not rate limits.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The gateway is a UUPS proxy; its default admin can grant bridge roles and UPGRADE_ROLE immediately.

controls.capDescription: The gateway can request remote representation mints and burn canonical collateral; totalBridgedSupply and availableSurplus provide supply-conserving route accounting but do not make this native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068610, the gateway proxy resolves to verified BRLVCanonicalGateway implementation 0xc25f26268c634057611151e76b4e8a3b51a35688. Its bridgedMint path validates configured remote domains, calls BRLV mintAssets, increments totalBridgedSupply, and emits an off-chain relayer request; bridgedBurn validates the remote domain and replay hash, decrements totalBridgedSupply, and calls BRLV burnAssets. This is canonical-side bridge machinery, not an independent native issuance chain.

controls.label: BRLVCanonicalGateway DEFAULT_ADMIN / UPGRADE_ROLE manager - EOA 0xc2f5fc

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can manage the gateway CONFIG_ROLE that validates configured remote domains.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50068610, the EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; getRoleAdmin(UPGRADE_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it can grant UPGRADE_ROLE, PAUSE_ROLE, or bridge roles without a timelock and replace the gateway implementation.

controls.capDescription: The zero-delay gateway default-admin path can grant bridge mint/burn, configuration, pause, and upgrade roles; it can therefore raise or replace the effective bridge route controls.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068610, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xc2f5fc350f579b8990180dab115ab6e0a3e118c3) returned true, hasRole(UPGRADE_ROLE, that EOA) returned false, getRoleAdmin(UPGRADE_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and eth_getCode returned 0x. The verified gateway implementation's _authorizeUpgrade requires UPGRADE_ROLE, so this zero-delay EOA can grant that role and replace the bridge gateway implementation; the same administrator can grant the gateway's CONFIG_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, BURNER_ROLE, and pause-related roles.

controls.label: BRLVCanonicalGateway CONFIG_ROLE holder

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: CONFIG_ROLE can alter the configured remote domains used by bridgedMint and bridgedBurn.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The role holder is administered by the gateway DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.evidence: Current Base reads at block 50068610 returned CONFIG_ROLE for 0x8fc7d0ca2e803c8c0737bb49da1d2623bbd76305. The role controls the gateway's configured remote domains and is part of the issuer-operated bridge route.

controls.label: BRLVCanonicalGateway MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Current Base hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x8bec53b3bd5590f93fba62fcdbce14aab411d8624) returned true at block 50068610. This role is a bridge-route minter on BRLVCanonicalGateway, not an independent native BRLV issuance authority.

controls.label: BRLVCanonicalGateway BURNER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Current Base hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, 0xd5fe1b38b1141202b54f6e294886a98438ca8dc4) returned true at block 50068610. This role controls the gateway's bridge-burn path and remains Bridge Risk evidence.

controls.label: BRLVRewards remote-domain bridgedSharesMint branch

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Remote-domain reward claims call gateway.bridgedSharesMint; the gateway validates remote domains and tracks totalBridgedSupply for the bridge route.
routeChecks.caps: Canonical-domain reward claims call brlv.mintShares against gateway.availableSurplus(); the remote branch is bridge machinery and is not independent native issuance.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: BRLVRewards is a UUPS proxy; its active UPGRADE_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controllers are recorded as separate Bridge Risk controls.

controls.capDescription: The BRLVRewards remote branch can mint bridge representations through the canonical gateway; its canonical-domain surplus-bounded branch remains in Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: The verified BRLVRewards source distinguishes canonical-domain claims, which call brlv.mintShares against gateway.availableSurplus(), from remote-domain claims, which call gateway.bridgedSharesMint. The remote branch is a bridge representation capability and is retained here separately from the native canonical reward control.

controls.label: BRLVRewards active UPGRADE_ROLE - EOA 0x548634

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The active UPGRADE_ROLE can replace the BRLVRewards UUPS implementation without a timelock, including the remote-domain bridgedSharesMint branch.

controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(UPGRADE_ROLE, 0x548634f237eae194f5e20982c9819d917fe17f04) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. The zero-admin-slot rewards proxy resolves to implementation 0x6818b4b2c3cc572726aed81a836b5e069519ad0a, whose verified _authorizeUpgrade requires UPGRADE_ROLE, giving this EOA an immediate upgrade path over the remote reward bridge branch as well as the canonical reward module.

controls.label: BRLVRewards DEFAULT_ADMIN / UPGRADE_ROLE manager - EOA 0x7ecf4c

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the BRLVRewards UPGRADE_ROLE administrator; it can grant or revoke the zero-delay upgrade role that replaces the remote reward bridge branch.

controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x7ecf4c03e7115a66c86ac9745cf0a8b903e3411f) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. getRoleAdmin(UPGRADE_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; therefore this zero-delay EOA can grant or revoke the rewards implementation's UPGRADE_ROLE, independently of the current 0x548634 holder, including over the remote bridge branch.

controls.label: BRLV Ethereum bridgedBRLV MINTER_ROLE — off-chain relayer EOA 0x039b41

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: bridgedBRLV mint() requires the supplied canonical domain to equal the configured Base canonical domain and rejects a processed canonical transaction hash.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The verified mint path has no aggregate or per-call mint ceiling; canonical-domain and replay checks are the on-chain route constraints.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The relayer is an EIP-7702 delegated EOA; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant or revoke its MINTER_ROLE.

controls.capDescription: The Ethereum representation minter is constrained by canonical-domain and processed-transaction checks, not by a reserve or per-call cap.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771220, the bridgedBRLV proxy resolves to implementation 0x57323db6d883811c17877d075e05ad9e2ed41519 and MINTER_ROLE is held by relayer EOA 0x039b419dafc801c3e375046efabd00813b0c48b6. The verified mint function checks the canonical domain and processed canonical transaction hash but is not an Ethereum native reserve/deposit mint.

controls.label: BRLV Ethereum bridgedBRLV BURNER_ROLE holder

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: BURNER_ROLE is administered by the Ethereum bridgedBRLV DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.evidence: Ethereum RoleGranted history and current reads at block 25771220 show BURNER_ROLE held by 0x161247c7c1b01715b1a3cc32f5036999c559a754. This is the burn side of the Ethereum bridgedBRLV representation route.

controls.label: BRLV Ethereum bridgedBRLV DEFAULT_ADMIN / UPGRADE_ROLE manager - EOA 0x239d4a

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls the bridgedBRLV canonical-domain configuration used by the off-chain relayer route.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No aggregate or per-call mint ceiling is enforced by the verified bridgedBRLV mint path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25771220, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 0x239d4a; it can grant UPGRADE_ROLE, PAUSE_ROLE, BLOCKLIST_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, or BURNER_ROLE immediately. No current UPGRADE_ROLE or PAUSE_ROLE holder was observed, so their absence is not a durable control guarantee.

controls.capDescription: The zero-delay default administrator can replace bridgedBRLV implementation logic or grant the representation's mint, burn, pause, and upgrade roles; the route has no reserve or per-call mint cap.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771220, the bridgedBRLV proxy resolves to implementation 0x57323db6d883811c17877d075e05ad9e2ed41519, with MINTER_ROLE held by relayer EOA 0x039b419dafc801c3e375046efabd00813b0c48b6, BURNER_ROLE held by 0x161247c7c1b01715b1a3cc32f5036999c559a754, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by 0x239d4a24efa36a8987b86184c080ace26b3a8968. The default admin can grant UPGRADE_ROLE, PAUSE_ROLE, or BLOCKLIST_ROLE immediately; this is an off-chain relayer/common-admin bridge failure domain, not an Ethereum native mint authority.
